penalties.essential_entities: Up to EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global turnover
penalties.important_entities: Up to EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global turnover

framework.name: NCSA 22-Topic Cybersecurity Framework
framework.description: Comprehensive 22-topic cybersecurity compliance framework published by the National Cybersecurity Authority

requirements.icsso: Entities must appoint an Information and Communication Systems Security Officer (ICSSO)

management_liability.description: Managing directors and legal representatives may be temporarily prohibited from exercising functions. Board must approve cybersecurity measures within 3 months of law entry into force.

incident_reporting.detailed_notification: 72 hours with interim updates on request

csirt.name: NCSA-CSIRT
csirt.note: The NCSA itself serves as the national CSIRT
